🌟 Open-Source-Face-Recognition-SDK | Python
🎯 Primary Use Case: Integrating robust and privacy-preserving face recognition capabilities into applications on Windows and Linux systems.
✨ Key Features: • 100% On-Premise processing • High Accuracy deep learning models • Real-Time Processing • Easy Python API integration • Cross-Platform (Windows/Linux)
📖 Summary: The Open Source Face Recognition SDK is a free, Python-based library for Windows and Linux that enables on-premise face detection, recognition, and comparison using deep learning models. It prioritizes data privacy by processing all information locally and offers real-time performance with optional GPU support.
